# iliad-122 (19.1–73) — new renderings

Format: Greek (line) | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose.

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ἠὼς μὲν κροκόπεπλος ἀπ’ Ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων / ὄρνυθ’, ἵν’ ἀθανάτοισι φόως φέροι ἠδὲ βροτοῖσιν· (19.1–2, dawn-formula) | "Dawn, saffron-robed, for her part, from the streams of Oceanus / was rising, so that to the immortals she might bring light, and to mortals;" | "Dawn in her saffron robe rose from the streams of Oceanus, to bring light to the immortals and to mortals alike;" | "yellow-robed", "the saffron-cloaked dawn"; second line is the Odyssey’s (5.2) and its wording is kept, κροκόπεπλος as at 8.1 |
| ἄγρια φῦλα μυίας (19.30–31) | "the savage tribes, the flies" | "the savage tribes of flies" | "wild", "fierce"; ἄγριος keeps the Odyssey’s "savage" (ἄγρια φῦλα Γιγάντων, 7.206) |
| ἀρηϊφάτους (φῶτας, 19.31) | "war-slain" | "killed in war" | "slain by Ares", "battle-slain" |
| εὐλάς (19.26) | "maggots" | "maggots" | "worms" (the word is the grub in a corpse) |
| χαλκοτύπους … ὠτειλάς (19.25) | "bronze-struck wounds" | "bronze-struck wounds" | "wounds made by bronze", "bronze-beaten"; ὠτειλή "wound" |
| ἐκ δ’ αἰὼν πέφαται (19.27) | "life has been killed" (between dashes) | "the life has been killed out of him" (between dashes) | "slain" (the table’s πέφαται is "has been killed", 17.689), "life is gone" (loses the verb), "is dead"; the perfect indicative after δείδω μή is kept as a parenthesis, and ἐκ is the preverb standing apart |
| τελεσφόρον εἰς ἐνιαυτόν (19.32) | "for a completion-bearing year" | "for a full year" | follows the Odyssey row (10.467), unchanged |
| ἄρειον · ἀρείων (19.33, 19.56) | "better" | "better" | "braver" (of men, 2.707), "stronger" (4.407, of a wall); applies the Odyssey row ἄρειον "better" (23.286). κέρδιον "better" (19.63) is another word with the same English, each from its own row; "braver" is for courage only |
| ἔμπεδος (χρώς, 19.33, 19.39) | "firm" | "firm" / "stay firm" | "sound", "unharmed"; follows ἔμπεδος "firm" (8.521, 11.813) |
| χρώς · χρόα (19.27, 19.33, 19.39) | "skin" | "flesh" (of a whole body) | "flesh" in `l` (kept for σάρξ; the table’s χρώς is "skin", 4.510, 8.43); the notes say that `i` "flesh" is the body |

| ὣς ἄρα φωνήσασα (19.12, 19.37) | "So then, having spoken" | "With these words" | follows the table’s ὣς ἄρα φωνήσασα (18.65, 18.388) |
